data.content_ref: inline:The target states the conjecture is settled when it is proven that the parity vector for every positive integer eventually matches the parity vector of some power of 2. This is logically circular or insufficient: matching a parity vector of a power of 2 does not inherently prove the sequence reaches 1 unless it is already established that such a vector uniquely and inevitably leads to the 4-2-1 sink.
